subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this Trim OS report be handled as a Gateway protocol-version/package compatibility bug, an external Trim OS packaging/config issue, or a deliberate new loopback auth-policy change?
rationale: The source points to protocol mismatch for code 1002, but the requested workaround touches Gateway auth boundaries and the reported config rewrite is not present in the checked-out OpenClaw code.

options.title: Request targeted auth/protocol evidence first
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway handshake logs, the first client connect frame, and exact installed CLI/Gateway package versions before choosing a code or packaging fix.

options.title: Treat as external package ownership
options.body: Route the config regeneration part to the Trim OS/TerraMaster package owner while keeping this issue focused on OpenClaw protocol compatibility only.

options.title: Design an explicit loopback policy
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned security/product discussion for any supported loopback-only pairing bypass or config knob before implementation.

recommendation.title: Request targeted auth/protocol evidence first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway handshake logs, the first client connect frame, and exact installed CLI/Gateway package versions before choosing a code or packaging fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway protocol compatibility and pairing history makes this the best available routing candidate for deciding whether the report is an OpenClaw protocol issue or a package/config boundary issue.
